keyPoints.en: Rainforest (Amazon, Congo, SE Asia), savanna (Africa: lion, zebra), hot desert (cacti, camel), Mediterranean (olive), temperate deciduous (oak), taiga (pine; moose), tundra (moss; reindeer).
keyPoints.bm: Hutan hujan (Amazon, Congo, Asia Tenggara), savana (Afrika: singa, zebra), gurun panas (kaktus, unta), Mediterranean (zaitun), hutan daun luruh sederhana (oak), taiga (pain; moose), tundra (lumut; rusa kutub).

keyPoints.en: Plants and animals are adapted to climate: needle leaves, stored water, thick fur and fat.
keyPoints.bm: Tumbuhan dan haiwan menyesuaikan diri dengan iklim: daun jarum, simpanan air, bulu tebal dan lemak.

keyPoints.en: Oxygen and carbon storage, climate regulation, food and medicine, raw materials, tourism and biodiversity; problems cross borders, so cooperation is needed.
keyPoints.bm: Oksigen dan simpanan karbon, mengawal iklim, makanan dan ubat, bahan mentah, pelancongan dan kepelbagaian biologi; masalah merentas sempadan, jadi kerjasama diperlukan.
